latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Alibaba Cloud Domain Query Skill.

- Enables querying Alibaba Cloud domain details by domain name, instance ID, or advanced search filters.
- Supports listing all domains under an account with pagination and sorting options.
- Implements a strict pre-flight checklist for CLI version, plugin, AI-mode, and credential validation before any API call.
- Enforces read-only operations and prohibits any action that reads or prints access keys or performs write operations.
- Provides detailed intent routing and mandatory security & compliance steps for all domain queries.
